description: This source file defines a SwiftUI widget called OpenClawLiveActivity, which utilizes ActivityKit to display a live activity related to 'OpenClaw' status with various UI components showing connection status, timer, and status indicator.

methods.name: lockScreenView
methods.description: Constructs the main view for the lock screen, displaying status dot, activity status text, and trailing view based on activity state.

methods.name: trailingView
methods.description: Returns a view representing the current connection state, showing progress indicator, icons, or timer accordingly.

methods.name: statusDot
methods.description: Returns a small Circle view colored based on the current activity state.

methods.name: dotColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the status dot based on activity state (disconnected, connecting, idle, or other).
